Terms of use.

Short version: the ledger is free information, read from providers’ own pages. Check the provider’s page before you buy. Paid extras are billed through Kit and you can cancel anytime.

The information

  • Prices, fees and specs come from each provider’s public pricing page or API, with the source and check date on every row (methodology). Providers change prices without notice, so data can be wrong or out of date. Always confirm on the provider’s page before buying.
  • Nothing here is financial, legal or procurement advice. The site is provided “as is”, without warranties.
  • VPSLedger is not affiliated with any provider. Trademarks belong to their owners. There are no affiliate links today; if we add any they will be labeled and will not affect ranking.

Using the data

The ledger data (JSON/CSV on /data) is licensed CC BY 4.0: reuse it freely with attribution to “VPSLedger” and a link to https://vpsledger.pages.dev/. Please don’t scrape the site at a rate that degrades it; use the files instead.

Pro

  • Pro costs $9/month or $90/year and is sold through Kit’s hosted checkout; payments are processed by Stripe via Kit. Prices are in USD; taxes may apply.
  • Pro is in early access: you get what is live on the Pro page today, and other listed features as they ship. Nothing is promised before it ships.
  • Cancel anytime from your Kit receipt or by emailing us; you keep access until the end of the period you paid for. For refund requests, email basileion.ops@gmail.com; we also honor any refund rights your local consumer law gives you.

Sponsor slots

  • A founding newsletter slot is $49 per placement, sold through Kit. Sponsors are always labeled “Sponsor” and never affect data or ranking. We accept infra, devtools and hosting-adjacent sponsors only; if we can’t run a placement you paid for, we refund it.

Liability

To the extent the law allows, our total liability for any claim about the site or a paid product is limited to what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing here limits rights you have under consumer law that can’t be waived.

Changes and contact

We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions: basileion.ops@gmail.com. Privacy: how we handle data.
